examples.title: Debt collection
examples.summary: Payment resolution, hardship, disputes, history and help. Speech corrections clear the old confirmation before a new payment approval.

examples.title: Patient intake
examples.summary: Intake, appointment management, information, nurse callbacks and documents. Caller-reported urgency from speech revokes routine booking proposals.

examples.title: Line support
examples.summary: Line diagnostics, outages, ticket status and account support, with preserved retest progress and approved service changes.

examples.title: Call screening
examples.summary: Screen and route calls, answer office questions, arrange callbacks, check message status and request appointments. Independent tasks and approved demo effects.

examples.title: Returns desk
examples.summary: Return resolution, shipment tracking, exchanges and policy questions, with eligibility checks and approved refunds.

examples.title: Table booking
examples.summary: Reservations, menu questions, private events and memory-backed preferences. Party policy and reminders use task-owned computed fields, watchers and patterns.

examples.title: Support assistant
examples.summary: Billing, FAQ, diagnostics and human handoff in one voice session, with independent task progress and explicit approval.

examples.title: Debt collection (workflow reference)
examples.summary: Verify, disclose, negotiate, take payment — charge gated on a confirmed promise to pay; extraction fills the amount and date from speech.

examples.title: Patient intake (workflow reference)
examples.summary: Identify, triage, schedule — scheduling hard-blocked on an emergency verdict; escalation stays ambient in every step.

examples.title: Line support (workflow reference)
examples.summary: Authenticate, run a line diagnostic, reset or raise a single-use engineer ticket — no ticket without a diagnostic.

examples.title: Call screening (workflow reference)
examples.summary: Identify the caller and intent, filter spam, transfer or take a message — transfer gated on the spam verdict from extraction.

examples.title: Returns desk (workflow reference)
examples.summary: Locate the order, check eligibility, refund once or offer credit — the refund is a single-use commit behind eligibility.

examples.title: Table booking (workflow reference)
examples.summary: Booking with durable memory: remembered diet and seating fill governed slots, a computed large-party flag steers the model, and booking stays gated on a real availability check.
